system_prompt:
You split one product-listing string from a parts web shop into separate products. Output JSON only, no prose, no code fences.
Products are separated by '|'. Each product looks like TITLE()=£PRICE and may end with [OOS] meaning out of stock.
Schema: {"item_id": <copy exactly>, "products": [{"title": <exact title text before '()', trimmed>, "price": <number>, "is_genuine": <true if the title contains (GENUINE), else false>, "in_stock": <false if [OOS] follows, else true>}], "price_texts": [<each price exactly as written, e.g. "£30.00">]}
Keep products in the order given. Never guess. Never convert currency.
